description: Every CIPP endpoint as a typed command, plus cross-tenant fan-out into a local store, offline joins across endpoints, and history over time.
auth_description: Azure AD bearer JWT for your self-hosted CIPP instance. Obtained via OAuth2 client-credentials against login.microsoftonline.com; 'auth login' performs the exchange and caches it. CIPP_API_KEY accepts a static bearer token.

novel_features.name: Cross-tenant fan-out runner
novel_features.description: Run any CIPP read endpoint across every client tenant at once and save the results locally.

novel_features.name: Cross-tenant posture matrix
novel_features.description: A per-tenant table for one chosen posture dimension (MFA, Conditional Access, Standards, BPA, DLP, retention or sensitivity labels) from the local store.

novel_features.name: Standards drift report
novel_features.description: Show every tenant whose Standards settings changed between two stored snapshots; --since picks the base snapshot.

novel_features.name: Throttle-aware bulk executor
novel_features.description: Drive CIPP deploy, user and mailbox actions from a CSV across tenants: plan-only unless --execute, with Retry-After backoff, per-row resume and HTTP-200 failure detection.

novel_features.name: License waste reconciler
novel_features.description: Total reclaimable licenses by SKU or by user from stored user license assignments and sign-in activity, with SKU names from stored license rows.

novel_features.name: Conditional Access cross-tenant diff
novel_features.description: Find which tenants deviate from the Conditional Access baseline the rest of the fleet shares.

novel_features.name: GDAP expiry and coverage sweep
novel_features.description: List delegated-admin relationships expiring inside a window, plus stored tenants with no active relationship (reads the partner-wide relationship list live; needs credentials).

novel_features.name: Stale account sweep
novel_features.description: List enabled, licensed accounts with no sign-in in N days from the stored users rows.

novel_features.name: Offboarding leftover check
novel_features.description: Find disabled accounts that still hold mail forwarding, inbox rules, directory roles or licenses.

novel_features.name: Snapshot change feed
novel_features.description: Show rows of any stored resource added, removed or modified between two fanout snapshots.

novel_features.name: One-tenant scorecard
novel_features.description: Every stored signal about one tenant in a single record, each with the time its data was saved.
